propositions: COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite when directing operators to add external ticket-comment evidence for retry.

ADR 0043 and completion_verifier.md:81-86 require the exact [operator-attested] tag to admit external evidence; untagged criteria default to codebase-verifiable and cannot be satisfied by ticket comments alone.

The operator followed incomplete remediation guidance, added a concrete ticket comment without the prerequisite tag, and received a contractually correct second FAIL because the criterion remained untagged.
Remediation guidance must distinguish repository-verifiable evidence from external operator-attested evidence and explicitly name the [operator-attested] tag requirement.
